critical_code_review_comments: Avatar.tsx:50-55 correctly gates image rendering to http(s):// and data: prefixes, guaranteeing that non-fetchable URIs (file://, content://, ph://, bare paths, undefined, null, empty) always fall through to the initials placeholder.

Avatar.tsx:60-68 always sets width/height/borderRadius on the wrapper View regardless of showImage, which is the root fix — the previous raw <Image source={{uri: undefined}}> collapsed on expo-image and gave zero-width avatars.
Avatar.tsx:28-33 initialsOf() handles empty ('?'), single-word (first 2 chars uppercase — 'Priya'→'PR'), and multi-word (first+last initial — 'Ramesh Kumar'→'RK') correctly.
Avatar.tsx:35-39 hashCode + PALETTE[hash%9] gives deterministic same-name-same-colour (verified: two 'Saqib Khan' rows both render amber rgb(202,138,4)).

server.py:820-840 diagnostic log line uses %s/%d formatters and only emits photo_b64_len (integer) — the base64 body itself is never written to the log stream. photo_kind correctly distinguishes 'photo_b64', 'photo(data-url)', 'photo(http)', 'photo(file:!!!)', 'photo(other)', 'none' for future forensics.

rca_of_issue: USER BUG: Employees list showed 3 cards (Saqib, Saqib Khan, Saqib Khan) with no visible avatar — the circle was collapsed to zero width. ROOT CAUSE: the previous code used raw `<Image source={{ uri: emp.photo ?? undefined }} style={styles.avatar}>` with expo-image. On some Android builds expo-image treats source={{uri: undefined}} as 'no source' and refuses to allocate the intrinsic 52×52 style, collapsing the flex parent. All 3 live DB rows have photo=NULL (regression from an earlier iteration where face-attendance capture stored NULL). FIX: new `/app/frontend/src/components/Avatar.tsx` component that (a) always renders a 52×52 (or size×size) rounded View regardless of whether an image is available, (b) only renders <Image> when the photo starts with http(s):// or data:, (c) otherwise draws the person's initials in a deterministic colour derived from a hash of the name. All 7 screens migrated. VERIFIED: live employees route now displays SA/SK/SK circles for the exact rows from the user's screenshot. No backend behavioural change beyond an INFO diagnostic log line at create_employee (verified not to leak base64).
